title: Crablet
description: The poller and its consumers, the write side and storage of a Crablet application. Queries are PromQL over the Prometheus names of the OTLP metrics; for another backend, swap the queries. Generated by scripts/build-dashboard.ts: edit that, not this file.

panels.title: Failed processors
panels.description: Processors whose status is FAILED: they stopped after too many errors and need a person (see Run it in production). Reported by every instance; counted once per processor.

panels.title: Paused processors
panels.description: Processors an operator paused.

panels.title: Modules without a leader
panels.description: Modules (views, automations, outbox) that have reported but whose leader has stopped reporting: no instance is running their processors. Leadership is per module, one advisory lock for all of a module's processors. A crashed leader never reports 0, so it is recognised by its series going quiet for two minutes. It also shows 1 when no leadership data is reported at all (a total outage: five minutes after the last instance stopped, its series are gone and there is nothing left to count).

targets.expr: (count(count by (lock_key) (crablet_poller_leadership_ratio) unless count by (lock_key) ((crablet_poller_leadership_ratio == 1 and (time() - timestamp(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio) < 120)))) or vector(0)) + (absent(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio) or vector(0))

panels.title: Processors reporting
panels.description: Processors known to the instances that are reporting. Zero means nothing is reporting at all.

panels.title: How is it doing right now?
Throughput
panels.description: Commands that succeeded, per second (each attempt of a retried command counts).

panels.title: Command p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of handling a command, retries included. Yellow above half a second, red above two.

panels.title: Slowest behind
panels.description: Age of the oldest event any processor has not handled yet; 0 when all are caught up. Yellow above 5 s, red above 30 s.

panels.title: Events waiting
panels.description: Events the processors have not handled yet, summed over processors (each counted up to 100 000).

panels.title: Conflict retries/s
panels.description: Commands that found their boundary changed and ran again. Some are normal under concurrency; a lot means contention. Yellow above 1, red above 10.

panels.title: Failed attempts/s
panels.description: Command attempts that failed, a retried conflict included (so this is not the number of commands that gave up: read it against the conflict retries beside it).

panels.title: Who leads, and who is behind?
Outbox leader
panels.description: The pod that leads the outbox module now: one advisory lock per module, so all of its processors run in that pod. Red when no pod does (a crashed leader drops out after two minutes).

targets.expr: max by (instance_id) (topk(1, timestamp((crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123456"} == 1 and (time() - timestamp(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123456"}) < 120))))) or label_replace(absent((crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123456"} == 1 and (time() - timestamp(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123456"}) < 120))) * 0, "instance_id", "NO LEADER", "", "")

panels.title: Views leader
panels.description: The pod that leads the views module now: one advisory lock per module, so all of its processors run in that pod. Red when no pod does (a crashed leader drops out after two minutes).

targets.expr: max by (instance_id) (topk(1, timestamp((crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123457"} == 1 and (time() - timestamp(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123457"}) < 120))))) or label_replace(absent((crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123457"} == 1 and (time() - timestamp(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123457"}) < 120))) * 0, "instance_id", "NO LEADER", "", "")

panels.title: Automations leader
panels.description: The pod that leads the automations module now: one advisory lock per module, so all of its processors run in that pod. Red when no pod does (a crashed leader drops out after two minutes).

targets.expr: max by (instance_id) (topk(1, timestamp((crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123458"} == 1 and (time() - timestamp(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123458"}) < 120))))) or label_replace(absent((crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123458"} == 1 and (time() - timestamp(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio{lock_key="4856221667890123458"}) < 120))) * 0, "instance_id", "NO LEADER", "", "")

panels.title: Leader changes in this range
panels.description: How many times a module changed hands in the time range selected above (a pod took a lock another had held). A deploy or a crash is one or more; a steady system is zero.

targets.expr: clamp_min(count(max by (lock_key, instance_id) (max_over_time((crablet_poller_leadership_ratio == 1)[$__range:1m]))) - count(count by (lock_key) (max_over_time(crablet_poller_leadership_ratio[$__range:1m]))), 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Who led what, over time
panels.description: One bar per pod and module, from when the pod took the module's lock to when it stopped reporting as leader. A handover is one bar ending and another starting; a gap between them is the time with no leader. The vertical marks on the other graphs are the same changes.

panels.title: Status of each processor
panels.description: Current status. Every instance reports the same value.

panels.title: Lag in events
panels.description: Events the processor selects that are committed and after its cursor, counted up to 100 000. Counted against the processor's own selection, not the end of the log. Every instance reports it, so the query takes the max.

panels.title: Lag in seconds
panels.description: Age, by the events' own occurred_at, of the first event waiting for the processor; 0 when it is caught up. Rising while the processor is ACTIVE means it is stuck or slow.

panels.title: Worst first
panels.description: Lag now, per processor, the slowest first.

panels.title: Events fetched per second
panels.description: Events the processor's loop fetched (the leader's work).

panels.title: Idle polls
panels.description: The share of polls that found nothing. High and steady is normal for a quiet system.

panels.title: Backed off
panels.description: 1 while the processor has backed off after errors or empty polls.

panels.title: Cursor position
panels.description: Where each processor has read up to.

panels.title: View projection failures
panels.description: Failures per second by view.

panels.title: Automation and outbox failures
panels.description: Failures per second: automations decide, outbox publishers publish (to something outside the process).

panels.title: View projection time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of one projection call, by view.

panels.title: Successful calls per second
panels.description: Projections, automation decisions and outbox publishes that succeeded, to read the failure panels against.

panels.title: Automation decision time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of one automation decision, by automation.

panels.title: Outbox publish time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of one publish call, by publisher.

panels.title: Events handled per second
panels.description: Events projected by views, handled by automations and published by the outbox.

panels.title: Stored events that could not be read
panels.description: A stored event the current definitions cannot decode: an unsafe event change (Evolving events). Should stay at zero.

panels.title: Appends per second
panels.description: Events appended, and append calls that failed.

panels.title: Wake-ups per second
panels.description: Notifications that tell pollers events were appended (ADR-0021): recorded per commit, actually sent, and saved by coalescing. Sent should stay near 1 / window per process.

panels.title: Contention
panels.description: Commands that retried after a conflict, appends the DCB condition refused, and commands recognised as repeats.

panels.title: Command time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of handling one command, by command type, retries included.

panels.title: Commands per second
panels.description: Commands that succeeded, and commands that failed (rejected by their rules or by an error) by command type.

panels.title: Append time (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of the conditional append.

panels.title: Reads that waited for views
panels.description: Reads that carried a consistency marker, per second by mode, and how long the waiting ones waited (p95).

panels.title: Time reads waited (p95)
panels.description: How long reads spent waiting for views to catch up (only reads that waited).

panels.title: Table size
panels.description: Total bytes (heap, indexes and TOAST) of each library table. Nothing deletes events, so watch the growth.

panels.title: Rows
panels.description: The planner's estimate, as fresh as the last autovacuum or ANALYZE.

panels.title: Bytes per event
panels.description: The events table and the tag table with their indexes, divided by events (about 1.2 KB at the time of writing).
